verdict.rationale: Antigravity Remote Control is a first-party feature for connecting to and driving Antigravity 2.0 desktop sessions on your machines from any web browser. That lets a developer start work on one machine and keep steering it later from another device or browser. The evidence is a single doc sentence, and it describes remote-driving a session that stays on its original machine, not syncing or handing the task off. Missing for 10: detail on whether a session can be moved or resumed natively on another machine, setup and limits documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser

citations.quote: Antigravity Remote Control allows you to securely connect to and drive your Antigravity 2.0 desktop sessions running across your machines from any web browser.
